mono.purpose: Code, commands, and literal technical values.

shadows.name: interactive-lift
shadows.purpose: Cards and pagination links on hover.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action in a focused choice set.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.9375rem 1.25rem; border: 1px solid var(--sl-color-accent); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--sl-color-accent); color: var(--sl-color-black); font: 600 1rem/1.1875 var(--sl-font); text-decoration: none; transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease, filter 0.2s ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 30px -10px var(--beryl-glow); filter: saturate(1.08); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--beryl-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A visible alternative that remains subordinate to the primary action.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.9375rem 1.25rem; border: 1px solid var(--sl-color-gray-4); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--sl-color-white); font: 600 1rem/1.1875 var(--sl-font); text-decoration: none; transition: transform 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: var(--beryl-magenta); color: var(--beryl-magenta); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--beryl-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Link Card
components.description: A contained navigation surface for related documentation.
components.css: .ds-card { display: grid; gap: 0.4rem; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; border: 1px solid var(--sl-color-gray-5); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--beryl-surface); color: var(--sl-color-white); font-family: var(--sl-font); text-decoration: none; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), border-color 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease; } .ds-card span { color: var(--sl-color-gray-2); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); border-color: var(--sl-color-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--sl-color-accent), 0 14px 40px -18px var(--beryl-glow); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--beryl-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Note Aside
components.description: A full-border callout for important documentation context.
components.css: .ds-aside { max-width: 75ch; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; border: 1px solid var(--sl-color-accent); border-radius: 14px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--sl-color-accent) 12%, var(--sl-color-black)); color: var(--sl-color-white); font-family: var(--sl-font); } .ds-aside strong { color: var(--sl-color-accent-high); } .ds-aside p { margin: 0.5rem 0 0; color: var(--sl-color-gray-2); }

components.name: Inline Code
components.description: Literal API names and commands embedded in prose.
components.css: .ds-inline-code { padding: 0.15em 0.4em; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--beryl-magenta-soft); color: var(--sl-color-white); font: 0.875em/1.4 var(--sl-font-mono); }

components.name: Pre-1.0 Badge
components.description: Persistent stability context attached to the site wordmark.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-block; padding: 0.3em 0.6em 0.25em; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--beryl-magenta) 45%, transparent); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--beryl-magenta-bright); font: 700 0.62rem/1 var(--sl-font); letter-spacing: 0.02em; }

components.name: Data Table
components.description: Compact reference data with restrained row separation.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--beryl-hairline); border-spacing: 0; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; color: var(--sl-color-gray-2); font: 0.95rem/1.5 var(--sl-font); } .ds-table th, .ds-table td { padding: 0.6rem 0.9rem; text-align: left; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--beryl-hairline) 55%, transparent); } .ds-table th { background: var(--beryl-surface); color: var(--sl-color-white); font-weight: 650; } .ds-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-table tbody tr { transition: background 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: var(--beryl-magenta-soft); }

narrative.overview:
The system treats documentation as a carefully equipped technical workbench cut from a green gemstone. Near-black green surfaces, warm off-white light surfaces, emerald actions, and a small morganite accent make the product feel crafted without competing with code. The visual voice is tactile, precise, and quietly playful.

The interface stays familiar enough for sustained reading. Expressive moments are concentrated in the faceted hero, display headings, status details, and interaction states. Long-form documentation remains calm, legible, and structurally conventional.
keyCharacteristics: Gemstone greens form the environment; morganite marks small moments of emphasis.
Unbounded gives the brand and page titles a wide, unmistakable silhouette.
Hanken Grotesk carries long-form reading and interface labels.
JetBrains Mono keeps code compact and developer-native.
Tonal layers define surfaces at rest; glow and lift appear during interaction.
Faceted geometry appears as a signature detail, not as repeated decoration.

rules.name: The Two-Stone Rule
rules.body: Emerald carries interaction and structure; morganite marks rare emphasis. Do not introduce an unrelated accent hue.

rules.name: The Theme-Pair Rule
rules.body: Light mode uses purpose-built darker accents and shadows. It is not the dark palette with opacity reduced.

rules.name: The Wide-Type Rule
rules.body: Unbounded belongs to the wordmark, page titles, and short display moments. Do not use it for paragraphs or dense navigation.

rules.name: The Code-Is-Code Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono marks executable or literal content; it is never a decorative substitute for interface typography.

rules.name: The Code-First Layout Rule
rules.body: Code samples can become the dominant visual object, but surrounding prose must retain a readable measure and an obvious route to the next action.

rules.name: The Resting-Stone Rule
rules.body: Surfaces stay tonally layered and nearly flat at rest. Glow is earned by focus, hover, or the singular hero object.

rules.name: The Facet-Sparing Rule
rules.body: Use faceted geometry for brand signatures and orientation, not as a border or background treatment on every container.

dos: Do keep code and technical content more visually prominent than decoration.
Do use emerald for links, focus, selection, and interactive structure.
Do reserve morganite for small, high-signal brand moments.
Do preserve the readable Hanken Grotesk body and familiar Starlight navigation model.
Do provide purpose-built dark and light treatments with WCAG AA contrast.
donts: Don't spread Unbounded across paragraphs, dense controls, or long navigation labels.
Don't add generic blue accents, gradient text, or unrelated SaaS colors.
Don't turn the interface into a grid of identical icon cards.
Don't apply glow to every resting surface.
Don't use faceted geometry as repeated wallpaper.
Don't trade code legibility or documentation scanability for brand expression.
